    """对本地 SQLite 数据库执行只读查询，返回结果行列表。"""

    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(sql)
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return rows

def check_password_strength(pw: str) -> dict:
    """检查密码强度并返回评分与建议，密码不会离开本机。"""
    score = 0
    if len(pw) >= 8: score += 1
    if re.search(r"[A-Z]", pw): score += 1
    if re.search(r"\d", pw): score += 1
    if re.search(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", pw): score += 1
    return {"score": score, "strength": "强" if score >= 4 else "中" if score >= 2 else "弱"}
